function.arguments: {"finding_id": 2, "resolution": "The channel was not randomly assigned — the email campaign was targeted at loyal customers, who have higher baseline conversion rates. This creates a confounding bias: any raw difference in conversion rates between email and paid_search could be due to segment differences, not the channel itself. To address this, I computed the conversion rate difference within each customer_segment (loyal, new, returning), then combined them using a weighted average based on segment size. This adjustment accounts for the imbalance in targeting and provides a valid estimate of the campaign effect, avoiding confounding."}
function.name: resolve_finding
